Its two neighbours f1 and f3 are borrowed the same way; this brief fixes the block Malcolm named and leaves them for a later wave.

MALCOLM, 2026-08-27: 'a modern clinical explainer image - in beautiful luxury beauty style - like the diagrams on this page: /pages/firming-skin-density'.

THE STYLE TARGET IS NAMED AND IT IS A LIVE FILE, NOT A DESCRIPTION. skingenetix-collagen-peptide-firming-skin-structure-diagram.jpg, block `approach` on /pages/firming-skin-density. Everything below that is not about PDRN is carried over from `block-firming-peptide-approach.json` unchanged and on purpose: SAME CAMERA (square on from the front, level, cut face parallel to the picture plane, no perspective, top surface reduced to a sliver along the upper edge), SAME BLOCK filling the frame, SAME EIGHT-LAYER STACK in the same order, SAME PALETTE, SAME pale hazy high-key ground, SAME delivery vocabulary of translucent glass spheres, descending shafts of warm white light, starburst glints at arrival and a response falling off smoothly with distance. Only the mechanism is new.

  1  QUILTED SURFACE   soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach, slightly felted
  2  SMOOTH FILM       a thin band of pale cream, faintly laminated at the cut edge
  3  GRANULAR BAND     small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely, a fine foam of tiny cells
  4  BASE PLATE        a thin smooth peach plate
  5  FIBRE LAYER       long thick glossy PEARL-WHITE bundles in loose parallel horizontal waves
  6  DERMAL FLOOR      a second thin smooth peach plate
  7  FAT CUSHION       two rows of large smooth glossy rounded lobules, pearly cream-blush
  8  GLASS BASE        a clear colourless acrylic plate

THE COPY NAMES TWO MECHANISMS AND THEY ARE THE WHOLE STRUCTURE OF THE PICTURE. Every slot carries both, at two different depths, exactly as the firming approach diagram carried its two:
  RECEPTOR      'Interacts with the adenosine A2A receptor, a pathway associated with the skin's
                renewal-related activity.' Whole ladders arrive at the BOTTOM ROW OF THE GRANULAR
                BAND — the renewal layer, which is where the skin-repair-renewal set already sends
                PDRN. Two granules there are larger than their neighbours and carry a shallow smooth
                cup moulded into the top. A ladder SEATS INTO A CUP, a starburst glint bursts at the
                contact, that granule lights from within and the band glows outward from it.
  SUPPLY        'Supplies nucleotides via the salvage pathway, associated with fibroblast and
                collagen activity.' Other spheres hold LOOSE SINGLE BEADS, not ladders — the ladder
                already come apart into its parts. Those go DEEPER, past the granular band into the
                FIBRE LAYER, where two rounded pearly cells gather them and NEW FINE PEARL STRANDS
                grow out of those cells and weave in among the existing bundles.

THE TWO ARE TOLD APART BY WHAT THEY ARE MADE OF, NOT BY COLOUR — the discipline the whole family runs on. Whole linked ladder = a signal arriving at a receptor. Loose unlinked beads = building blocks being supplied and reused. A viewer does not need a label to see that one is a message and the other is material.

THE LADDER IS A SPEC, NOT A LOOK, AND IT MUST NOT TWIST. PDRN is a polynucleotide: SHORT FLAT LADDER, two parallel rows of pearl beads joined by EXACTLY SIX fine crossbars, lying flat and face-on. A spiral turns it into the DNA-double-helix stock cliché, which is the one thing the skin-repair-renewal set negated from the start and which the last PDRN wave still produced. Helix, spiral, coil and twist are negated by name, the rung count is written down so a candidate can be FAILED on it, and the check is a count at 100% zoom, not a glance.

NO FISH. The copy says 'derived from salmon DNA' and that sentence is not in the prompt for exactly this reason — an engine that reads 'salmon' puts a salmon in the frame or turns the palette to fish-flesh orange. The source of the ingredient is a fact for the words, not a subject for the picture. Salmon, fish, scales and marine life are negated.

AND ABSOLUTELY NOTHING INJECTED. This matters more on this page than on any other on the store: PDRN's public reputation is as an injectable 'salmon DNA skin booster', so an engine reaching for the familiar image of this ingredient reaches for a syringe. Skingenetix sells a topical. Needle, syringe, cannula, injection, skin booster, mesotherapy, vial and ampoule are all negated by name.

CLAIMS DISCIPLINE. The copy is hedged twice over — 'a well-studied ingredient', 'what laboratory research describes', 'a pathway ASSOCIATED WITH'. What is depicted is ARRIVAL, CONTACT and a LOCAL RESPONSE FALLING OFF WITH DISTANCE. What is NOT depicted: any before-and-after, any comparison, any number, any percentage, any measurement, any face. Nothing is broken or frayed anywhere in the frame — this is the supported state, and there is no deficit half to this pair.

PALETTE, AND THE ONE OPEN QUESTION IN THIS BRIEF. Concepts A and C hold the firming family's palette exactly: peach-cream tissue, pearl-ivory fibre, pale hazy cool ground, nothing tinted, no brand colour anywhere. Concept B is the variant — the same frame with the faintest BLUSH PINK in the ladder rungs and in the bloom at the contact points, tying the block to this page's own header banner, where blush-pink helices sit on graphite. B is the only slot where a tint appears and it is deliberate; if Malcolm prefers the pure family match, A and C are already it.

SQUARE 2048x2048, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED. Live on /pages/pdrn-research, 2026-08-27, the f2 image box: 660x660 (1.000) at 1440, 580x580 (1.000) at 1280, 540x621 (0.870) at 1200, 490x549 (0.893) at 1100, 452x573 (0.789) at 1024, 704x704 at 768, 350x350 at 390. So it is square at desktop and on phones and stretches only in the 1000-1250 band, where `cover` takes up to 10.5% off each side. A square master is therefore right — a taller one would stretch the row past its siblings — but the block must be composed to survive a side crop: KEEP THE SUBJECT CENTRED AND LEAVE 12% OF CLEAR HAZY MARGIN AT BOTH SIDE EDGES. That is written into every prompt as an edge condition rather than left to luck.

HANDEDNESS: `alternate_media_position` is true on this section and f2 is the second block, so the image renders on the RIGHT with text to its left. The composition is centred and symmetrical, so this costs nothing — recorded so a later session does not re-derive it.

CLASS B — no product in frame, no references attached, no product description and no brand identity given to any engine. FLUX.2 and Luma are both in the run. Note that generate-multi.py concatenates only `negative_global` and `negative_extra`, never `negative_class_b`, so everything that must reach an engine is in the global list.

JUDGE AT 100% AND AGAIN AT RENDER SIZE. Four checks: RUNG COUNT — six crossbars per ladder, and any ladder that spirals fails outright. BEAD STATE — the deep spheres must hold loose unlinked beads, not more ladders, or the two mechanisms collapse into one. HOLLOW TUBE ENDS — any fibre end in shot must be solid, the fault that killed a candidate on the firming wave. EDGE MARGIN — measure the clear margin at both sides against the 10.5% worst-case crop before anything is published.

slots.title: A · family match — pure palette, ladders to the cell band, loose beads to the fibres
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section SEEN SQUARE ON FROM THE FRONT. The camera is level with the middle of the block and directly in front of it, so the cut face is exactly parallel to the picture plane, its edges horizontal, with no perspective and no convergence. The top surface is not seen as a plane — at most the thinnest sliver of it shows along the upper edge. The block is centred and does NOT reach the sides of the picture: a clear band of empty hazy air, about a tenth of the picture's width, is left open along the left edge and along the right edge, and more clear hazy air is left open above it. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm, pale and matte; nothing in the frame is dyed or tinted.

THE LAYERS SIT DIRECTLY ON ONE ANOTHER, IN CONTACT, one solid continuous slab. From top to bottom, in this exact order: a narrow band of surface made of soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach and slightly felted; a thin smooth band of pale cream, finely laminated where it is cut; a thick band of small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely like a fine foam of tiny cells; a thin smooth peach plate; then, filling the middle of the block, a deep zone of long thick glossy fibre bundles in a pale pearl ivory, almost white with only the faintest warm gold in their highlights, lying in loose parallel horizontal waves through a soft peach-cream ground, glassy and translucent and crisply defined against it, every bundle whole and solid with no cut or open ends; a second thin smooth peach plate; and at the bottom a deep cushion of large smooth glossy rounded lobules in a pearly cream-blush, packed in two rows like a bed of eggs. The whole block stands on a thin clear colourless glass plate.

FLOATING IN THE HAZY AIR ABOVE THE BLOCK ARE FIVE TRANSLUCENT SPHERES OF CLEAR PALE GLASS, of slightly different sizes and at slightly different heights. Two kinds hang there, and they hold different things.

THREE OF THEM HOLD A SHORT FLAT LADDER OF PEARL-WHITE BEADS: two parallel rows of small beads joined by exactly six short fine crossbars, lying perfectly flat and face-on like a tiny stepladder, straight and level, never curled, never twisted and never wound around itself. From the underside of each of these three spheres a slender shaft of warm white light descends STRAIGHT DOWN, piercing the quilted surface and the cream film and reaching the BOTTOM ROW OF THE GRANULAR BAND, and no further. Sitting in that bottom row are TWO GRANULES NOTICEABLY LARGER AND SMOOTHER THAN THEIR NEIGHBOURS, each with a shallow rounded cup moulded into its upper surface like a small dish. One flat ladder is settling neatly INTO one of those cups, seated in it and fitting it exactly. Where it lands a bright star-shaped glint bursts, that large granule glows warmly from inside, and the surrounding granules brighten in a soft bloom that fades smoothly away with distance, with no line and no edge.

THE OTHER TWO SPHERES HOLD LOOSE SINGLE PEARL-WHITE BEADS, unlinked and separate, a small drift of tiny individual seed pearls with no bars and no rows between them. From the underside of each of these, a slender shaft of warm white light descends much FURTHER DOWN, straight through the granular band and DEEP INTO THE ZONE OF FIBRE BUNDLES. Resting among the bundles there are TWO SMOOTH ROUNDED PEARLY CELLS, plump and egg-like, and the loose beads drift down into them. Those two cells are lit from within, and out of each of them several FINE NEW PEARL-IVORY STRANDS are growing and weaving in among the older bundles, so that close to those cells the bundles are visibly thicker, denser and more numerous, and further away toward the sides of the block they are ordinary — thinner, plainer, more widely spaced — the change between the two smooth and gradual. Small bright sparkles drift in the lit zones.

Nothing is broken, nothing is frayed and nothing is falling apart anywhere in the picture. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
